svg.title: Ziganya weekly contribution and clock-in flow
svg.desc: Flowchart showing the full path from a member tapping clock-in through duplicate prevention, M-Pesa auto-pay, admin verification, and the missed payment escalation path.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens when a Ziganya member taps clock-in?')
sendPrompt('How does Ziganya prevent duplicate clock-ins in the same week?')
sendPrompt('What message does a member see if they already clocked in this week?')
sendPrompt('How is a Ziganya contribution record created in the database?')
sendPrompt('What is auto-pay via M-Pesa in Ziganya?')
sendPrompt('How does M-Pesa STK Push work for Ziganya auto-pay?')
sendPrompt('What happens after M-Pesa callback confirms payment in Ziganya?')
sendPrompt('How does Ziganya notify the admin when a member clocks in?')
sendPrompt('How does a Ziganya admin verify a contribution payment?')
sendPrompt('What happens when a Ziganya contribution is marked as missed?')
sendPrompt('What happens after a Ziganya contribution is verified?')
sendPrompt('How does verifying a contribution update the Ziganya dashboard?')
sendPrompt('What does the member see after their contribution is confirmed?')
